attchmntText: Copy Of Newspaper Publication - Financial Results For The Second Quarter and half-year Ended 30Th September 2026
voiceSummary: Siemens Limited has filed information with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company published newspaper advertisements in Business Standard and Navshakti on 7th November 2026. These advertisements concern the financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The filing was made by Ketan Thaker, Company Secretary. The document serves to place these published advertisements on record with the exchanges.

attchmntText: Siemens Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
